services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: In this 7-week long, beginner-friendly course, you will learn the techniques to make your own stained-glass creation using equipment and tools provided in our Visual Arts Studio. However, you must purchase your own glass. Glass is $30 or more depending on the quality. The first class will be an orientation; design template ideas, glass retail options, and an overview of the equipment that you will use. This free gathering includes dinner catered by Aramark Collegiate Hospitality, an interactive art activity, art demonstration, and table read. services.name: Pottery class
services.desc: In this 5-week handbuilding class you will learn to combine pinch pots to make such things as vases, teapots, fruit items, or something of your own choice. We'll use slabs on slump molds, and combine that with coils for elaborate ways to enhance your slump form. You will learn decoration methods using texture tools and stencils, and other ways to color your creation. All finished pieces will be glazed and fired. This class is suitable for both beginners who have never worked with clay and those with some experience who want to expand their skills. services.name: Art Exhibitions
services.desc: Annual Open Exhibit & Art Show is a curated and judged art show for artists in McMinn and surrounding counties. Adam Romano is a fine artist, curator, and retired tattooist, who shows at galleries in the United States & lives in Chattanooga, TN. He was born in Chicago, IL, raised in the carnival business, and has lived around the United States. He has a bachelor’s degree in art and has shown in galleries, museums, and private homes, including over 30 art exhibitions. Adam completed a traditional tattoo apprenticeship then travelled to develop as an artist. He has owned a studio and researched the history of tattoo as well as grief in modern society. services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Our facility has a variety of rooms and spaces that can accommodate from 30 to 200 people. The Willson Exhibit Room can accommodate 30-50 people, while The Peggy Dow Center can hold 50-75, depending on seating arrangements. The Sue E. Trotter Theater can accommodate up to 200 in theater seating. The theater is a great venue for receptions, parties, dinners, meetings, and performances. Spaces in The Arts Center are available when not in use for AACA programming and events. The first step in the rental process is to confirm whether an appropriate space is available on your desired date(s).
